parsed.notes: The 2026 Credit Agreement requires a maximum total net leverage ratio and a minimum fixed charges coverage ratio, both tested quarterly, but the excerpt gives neither actual values nor limits. It says only that the Company was in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The 3.0x net leverage ratio in the 2028 Senior Notes indenture is a restricted-payments test in a bond indenture, so it is excluded. The total net leverage ratio references that set the interest margin and the unused commitment fee are pricing grids, also excluded.
